The user would not be flexible about the correct patient, encounter type, exact note text, or introducing any extra modifications; minor UI or phrasing details are flexible.

Evidence shows 'Encounter for patient p1' with Type: Triage, the note exactly 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note,' and a single green banner stating 'Saved: Triage encounter for p1: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note.' There is no sign of multiple saves or other edits. The outcome fully satisfies the user's primary intent.

Full credit if the app is used as specified, or if the app is inaccessible (errors, downtime, login wall, captcha) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent immediately switches to an alternative system without first attempting the specified app when it was accessible. Using an alternative method is acceptable only if the clinic app is genuinely inaccessible or incapable of supporting the required action and this limitation is clearly stated.

items.criterion: Create a new encounter with type 'Triage'
items.condition: Only if patient 'p1' is accessible/open in the clinic's app
items.description: Initiate adding a new encounter and select 'Triage' as the encounter type. Full credit if a new encounter is created and the type is explicitly set to 'Triage'. Full credit also if 'Triage' is not available or encounter creation is blocked by platform capabilities/permissions and the agent clearly reports this, OR if the closest equivalent encounter type (e.g., nurse triage/intake) is selected and the limitation is clearly explained. items.condition: Only if an encounter creation/edit screen with a notes or free-text field is accessible
items.description: Input the note text exactly as provided: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note. Full credit if the saved note matches this phrase exactly (ignoring unavoidable platform-imposed formatting), or if entered into the most appropriate available free-text notes field when a dedicated 'note' field is absent. Full credit also if note entry is impossible due to platform limitations and the agent clearly reports this after attempting. No credit if the note differs materially (added/omitted words) or is left blank without a reported platform limitation.

items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1: Note field contains 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note'; the banner repeats the exact text.
items.post_image_justification: The exact provided note text was entered and is visible in the saved confirmation.

items.criterion: Save the encounter exactly once (commit the record)
items.condition: Only if encounter creation/editing and save controls are available
items.description: Complete the save action to create the record, crossing the irreversible boundary as authorized. Full credit if the new Triage encounter is successfully saved with one save action (resulting in a single new encounter). Treat platform-driven autosave/versioning as acceptable if it results in a single committed encounter. Full credit also if saving is impossible due to platform limitations/permissions and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if save attempts face platform errors but are reported clearly, or if multiple save clicks were required due to validation/errors yet only one encounter is ultimately created. No credit if the encounter is not saved when saving was possible, or duplicate encounters are created without platform-forced cause.
items.justification: Action 3 clicked the Save button once; State 4 indicates the page after Save with no repeated save attempts or errors.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1: Single green 'Saved' confirmation is visible; no indication of multiple saves or errors.
items.post_image_justification: The presence of a single save confirmation supports that the encounter was saved exactly once.

items.criterion: Make no other changes beyond the requested action
items.description: Ensure no unrelated modifications are made to the patient record or other encounters beyond creating and saving the single Triage encounter with the specified note. Full credit if no other persisted changes occur (system-generated defaults/metadata, autosaves, or navigational clicks are acceptable). Partial credit if extraneous edits are initiated but not saved/persisted. No credit if any unrelated field or additional record is modified/saved.
items.justification: The agent only set the Type to Triage, entered the specified note, and saved. No other edits or records were modified.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1: Only 'Type: Triage' and the specified Note are present; no other fields or records show changes.
items.post_image_justification: No unrelated modifications are evident beyond the requested type and note entry.

No substitutions, additional records, or unrelated fields were modified. All existing criteria already covered the expected behavior and scored full points. There are no lasting, material side effects beyond the requested action, so no new penalty is warranted.
